content: Orchestrator now has its own phase file, orchestrate.jsonl, closing the gap where its opening frame was silently living inside Planner's file. This is also the first trail where role-to-file ownership is clean end to end — a small milestone for the trail-as-product discipline itself. The 3 earlier sealed trails (905190b8, 2ac26e91, 2620df98) are left as historical record, not migrated — sealed evidence stays sealed. Next real gap: the queued task-hand-simulate-orchestrate-run seed is now slightly more concrete, since it can exercise the mint-or-link + orchestrate.jsonl logging together in one pass.

next_seed.messy_seed_text: hand-simulate one full /pmcro-orchestrator:orchestrate run --task <x> call end to end — preconditions, the initialize call, the orchestrator's own orchestrate.jsonl entry, hand-off to Planner — using -OutputPath so it costs nothing to throw away
